cases.title: a participant who has never existed registers with no operator involvement
the new participant can sign in immediately, with no activation step
a new account starts with NO entitlement and NO subscription, and says so
the participant creates their own first site; no site is pre-created for them
the participant creates their own first inspection
the participant records an observation against that inspection
an ordinary participant cannot grant themselves an entitlement
an ordinary participant cannot revoke an entitlement either
a configured promo code confers Pro through a BOUNDED grant, with no database change
the comped account carries NO subscription, so nothing may present it as a purchase
/login — the email field is type=email (O-14)
signed out, every authenticated route renders something honest — no blank page, no stuck loading state, no raw server error, no privileged content
and every one of them offers a way out
signed in, every critical route survives direct navigation and a browser refresh
and none of it produced a 5xx
an expired session never renders an unqualified zero — every stale figure says what kind of figure it is
and the dead session is cleared rather than kept
so the next navigation lands on sign-in
password reset email is NOT configured, so the page says so and does not offer a form whose success message would be false
